notes.title: New Demo
notes.content: [h3][b]Major update[/b][/h3][p]After launching the very first demo, I realized that something [b]needed to be changed[/b] in it! All thanks to the players who made videos and shared their opinions! [b]Thank you so much![/b][/p][p]It's thanks to you that I [b]FULLY[/b] redid the entire demo and story from scratch! As far as I'm concerned, I made it better! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45589160/d4d190535666f72ba1c97c73b290e39af2e821fa.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]New plot:[/b] [/h3][p]You have money problems and decide to take a very risky gamble. An ancient tomb was found in an abandoned mine, but a group of archaeologists disappeared there and it is going to be closed! You decide to infiltrate and steal ancient artifacts to sell them on the black market![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45589160/e111909739ac235d182a4d3e82b3ae66380b167f.gif"][/img][/p][p]I hope you enjoy the new content! I tried to add more atmosphere, more interactions, and also, showed the monster as many asked for! Enjoy the game![/p]
